limitations: Two separate seeds/processes, one warmup and three timed requests per policy; descriptive medians, not confidence intervals.
Complete requests include decode/export and repeated audio VAE setup; not compilation-free end-to-end.
Nonoverlap and shared lock do not rule out unrelated external device load.
Cross-policy byte identity is descriptive only; SIMD RMS may legitimately change BF16 rounding.
Performance alone never promotes a default; independent numerical gates and explicit aggregate/tail quality review remain required.

performance_quality_video_binding.scope: Four validated original 124-frame resident exports match the reviewed same-seed/policy capture by SHA256. Video byte identity does not establish latent exactness.

actual_activation_evidence.scope: Actual H-trajectory rows; sampled output channels/full K. Quantization evidence is separate from GPU GEMM implementation proof.

quality_review.scope: Explicit numeric aggregate/tail review for default selection. Limited sampled still inspection only; continuous motion/audio listening and perceptual acceptance remain unevaluated.

reviews.reviewer: Codex root; independent JSON audit by upstream_audit

findings.per_step_latents: video: 14/20 steps have greater BF16-relative L2; candidate/baseline ratios range 0.741015 to 1.21542; audio: 18/20 steps have greater BF16-relative L2; candidate/baseline ratios range 0.827638 to 1.75283. All 42 tensors are finite; disabled-flag baseline exactly replays the historical FC2-H trajectory.
findings.final_video_latent: BF16-relative L2 0.335791037 -> 0.403528022; SNR 9.478618 -> 7.882526 dB. This is numerical drift, not perceptual ground truth.
findings.final_audio_latent: BF16-relative L2 0.115167462 -> 0.197489928; SNR 18.7734 -> 14.0891 dB. This is numerical drift, not perceptual ground truth.
findings.decoded_rgb: RGB SSIM 0.704099592 -> 0.6518363; RGB SNR 13.24072 -> 11.74637 dB. Six sampled frames retain a fox walking in snow with pose/timing differences; continuous motion quality was not assessed.
findings.decoded_pcm: PCM SNR 15.29095 -> 10.99493 dB; relative L2 0.171969965 -> 0.282002888. Exact 32kHz stereo duration/alignment passed; no listening claim.
findings.activation_quantization_aggregate_and_ta: All 18 sampled real QKV/FC1 cases improve projection aggregate relative L2 on identical X/W; all 288/288 selected rows improve relative L2. 1/288 rows regress in maximum absolute error. These isolated tail exceptions are retained, not used as an automatic veto. Prep independent references and rotation checks pass. CPU same-X/W projections sample channels with full K and do not independently prove GPU GEMM correctness.
findings.bf16_relative_material_regression: Reject default promotion on the combined aggregate and tail evidence: both final latent streams and decoded RGB/PCM drift worsen versus the existing FC2-H baseline. Local projection improvements do not offset this repeated whole-model regression. This rejects the numerical policy for this recipe; it does not certify perceptual inferiority or require every individual metric to improve.
